surfaces.name: --flavor-hue
surfaces.role: oklch hue angle of the neutral surfaces (the flavor axis)

surfaces.name: --flavor-on
surfaces.role: flavor strength 0..1 — scales surface chroma; 0 is a pure grey base

surfaces.name: --bg-dim
surfaces.role: sunken well: input, table and log surfaces cut into the page

surfaces.name: --bg-header
surfaces.role: header bar of a raised thing (card, panel, table head) — the lightest resting shade

surfaces.name: --bg-hover
surfaces.role: hover-state fill (transient only, never a resting surface)

surfaces.name: --df-panel-header-bg
surfaces.role: header bar override (.df-card, druid-log-view, druid-subtabs, druid-table)

lines_text.name: --border-strong
lines_text.role: edges that must read as edges (table rules, sticky header underline)

accent.name: --df-accent
accent.role: component accent override (defaults to --accent; df-* classes repoint it)

shape.name: --df-table-min-width
shape.role: width floor of a .df-table.wide, and of any table with 5+ columns under 720px, so the wrap scrolls horizontally instead of squeezing (defaults to 620px)

shape.name: --radius-sm
shape.role: tighter radius for dense chrome (inputs, cells, chips)

shape.name: --df-main-pad
shape.role: padding of the page's <main> (defaults to 30px 22px, 16px 12px under 720px); df-shell-compact sets it to 10px

shape.name: --df-main-max
shape.role: max width of the page's <main> (defaults to 1100px); df-shell-compact sets none

focus.name: --focus-ring
focus.role: box-shadow halo applied on :focus-visible across light and shadow DOM

focus.name: --glow
focus.role: the same halo as a resting glow for lit elements

motion.name: --df-ease
motion.role: shared easing curve — quick out, unhurried settle

motion.name: --df-empty-mark
motion.role: brand leaf as a CSS mask url, published by theme.ts for .df-empty
